aboutBio: Focused on engineering LLM applications: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agent / multi-agent workflow orchestration, and local model deployment (AMD ROCm / ONNX / llama.cpp). Experienced in end-to-end delivery of multimodal systems spanning visual perception, LLM reasoning and closed-loop handling, plus medical compliance RAG systems. Passionate about open source and knowledge accumulation.
aboutJ1Desc: Built a personal blog and study-notes site with React / Vue, starting engineering-driven documentation and knowledge accumulation.
aboutJ2Desc: Completed a medical compliance RAG system, then brought the outcome to the AMD Radeon Hackathon to build an auditable, fully-local office assistant.
aboutJ3Desc: Open-sourced the construction-site guardian: self-trained YOLOv8 + multi-agent collaboration + RAG standard retrieval, covering the full loop from visual perception to closed-loop handling.
aboutJ4Desc: Keeps iterating on the blog and Skills assets, turning engineering experience into reusable open-source content.
aboutProjectDesc: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for medical scenarios, layering multiple enhancement mechanisms on top of traditional RAG architecture to ensure trustworthy, traceable, and auditable answers: dual-layer compliance guardrail filtering, LangGraph self-reflection re-check loop, medical knowledge graph multi-hop reasoning, layered long-term memory, and end-to-end auditable traceability.
aboutProjectStack: Python · LangChain · LangGraph · FastAPI · LangServe · Vector Database
aboutProjectStatus: Preparing to deploy to Render for long-term maintenance
